research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Veracyte is researching and developing methods, systems, and kits for molecular profiling and diagnostics, focusing on cancer and genetic disorders. Their work includes genetic signatures to predict prostate cancer metastasis, algorithms for thyroid cancer diagnostics, classifiers for sample identification, and biomarkers for subtyping prostate and breast cancers. They also develop approaches for lung disorder identification and nucleic acid sequencing, highlighting efforts in cancer diagnostics and molecular classification.

overview_description.description: Veracyte is a global genomic diagnostics company that improves patient care by providing answers to clinical questions, informing diagnosis and treatment decisions throughout the patient journey in cancer and other diseases. The company’s growing menu of genomic tests leverage advances in genomic science and technology, enabling patients to avoid risky, costly diagnostic procedures and quicken time to appropriate treatment. The company’s tests in thyroid cancer, lung cancer, breast cancer, and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis are available to patients, and its lymphoma subtyping test is in development. With Veracyte’s exclusive global license to a best-in-class diagnostics instrument platform, the company is positioned to deliver its tests to patients worldwide.

about_short_description.short_description: Veracyte develops molecular diagnostic tests to improve patient outcomes and lower healthcare costs.

product.name: Decipher Prostate Genomic Classifier
product.description: A 22-gene genomic test that estimates the likelihood of prostate cancer metastasis and supports personalized treatment planning after diagnosis or prostate surgery.

product.name: Afirma Genomic Sequencing Classifier (GSC)
product.description: A genomic test for indeterminate thyroid nodules that helps classify nodules as benign or suspicious and provides molecular information to support treatment decisions.

product.name: Prosigna Breast Cancer Assay
product.description: A breast cancer gene-expression assay that evaluates tumor biology and recurrence risk to support adjuvant treatment decisions for patients with early-stage breast cancer.

product.name: Decipher Bladder Genomic Classifier
product.description: A genomic subtyping test for bladder cancer that classifies tumor biology and supports risk assessment and treatment decisions, including consideration of neoadjuvant chemotherapy.

product.name: Percepta Lung Cancer Genomic Classifier
product.description: A genomic test for lung cancer that uses tumor biology to support diagnostic and treatment decisions, including assessment of malignancy risk in selected lung nodules.

product.name: MRD Testing Platform
product.description: A molecular residual disease testing platform based on circulating tumor DNA analysis for detecting and monitoring residual cancer after treatment.
